about: data.dev's general assistant asked about the open data it reads (T-4359). Every number, name and dataset an answer must give is read live at question time from `truth`: the catalogue (CKAN action API on JC_CKAN_URL) or the public Endpoint (NGSI-LD on JC_GATEWAY_URL, anonymously, as the assistant reads it). `must` adds facts every right answer holds whatever the live value. Questions written 2026-10-16 from the 12 datasets data.dev listed then.
